presentation.text: Atlantic Patagonia reveals a different side of Argentina's southern wilderness. Along its immense coastline, the Atlantic Ocean meets dramatic cliffs, remote beaches and protected natural reserves that shelter extraordinary marine life. The Valdés Peninsula, Puerto Madryn and Punta Tombo offer remarkable opportunities to discover whales, penguins, sea lions and other species in their natural habitats. It is a destination where nature takes centre stage and every encounter feels extraordinary.
